res: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.d: The hezrou has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the hezrou must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the hezrou's stench for 24 hours.

actions.d: The hezrou makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

The demon chooses what to summon and attempts a magical summoning.
A hezrou has a 30 percent chance of summoning 2d6 dretches or one hezrou.
A summoned demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner, acts as an ally of its summoner, and can't summon other demons. It remains for 1 minute, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

tips: Иммунитет к урону: poison — не тратьте на это ресурсы, ищите другой тип урона.
Сопротивление урону: cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks — вполовину менее эффективно, предпочтите другой тип.
Иммунитет к состояниям: poisoned — заклинания/эффекты с такими состояниями не подействуют.
Слабый спасбросок: Интеллект (-3) — эффекты и заклинания на эту характеристику с высокой вероятностью пройдут.
Мультиатака — наносит несколько ударов за ход. Эффекты обездвиживания/оглушения особенно ценны против него.
